skyTools.stabilization: Stronger stabilization when zoomed in, with faster tracking as you move.

scopeSky.title: Find with your telescope on the sky
scopeSky.phoneTop: Place your phone parallel to the tube, with its top edge pointing toward the front. Align with a bright star to reduce pointing error.
scopeSky.rings: The dashed outer ring is the finder field; the solid inner ring is the eyepiece field. Sizes use your saved equipment.
scopeSky.preview: Preview · not the actual tube direction

hopJourney.chartHint: The dashed ring is your {{fov}}° finder field. This wider context chart shows more sky than the actual finder.
hopJourney.lostHelp: Return to the last bright star you identified. Lower the magnification and compare two or three nearby stars. If the pattern is inverted, match your finder type below.
